title: Error Mode Cartography and Quickplay Panels for Oncall Triage
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a set of dashboards and lightweight playbooks that help oncall rapidly triage and remediate the dominant error modes across the inference stack. Provide multi-dimensional views (cartography) that correlate top-level symptoms to likely causes: client timeouts, service queue overload, model rejections, grpc/http error codes, and kernel/runtime spikes. Integrate trace-hook context and log/metric pointers to surface a 90s triage path for paged incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard surfaces top 6 error facets with drilldowns: timeout, queue_overload, model_reject, bad_payload, http_5xx, grpc_14
Each facet links to at most 3 likely root causes with representative traces and sample logs
Trace-hook changes include a 64-byte contextual tag for routing reason and a request-level 'rejection_reason' enum
Playbook quicksteps documented in Console link and available as an 'Open Runbook' action from the dashboard
Alert -> ticket mappings produced for SLO-aligned noise reduction: adjust alert thresholds to reduce false positives by >=30% in staged tests
